rationale: Normal band is [0.90, 1.10] pu. 8 of 10 samples lie inside it (80%), below the 95% requirement, so the series is non-compliant. t03 and t04 are below 0.90 pu; no samples exceed 1.10 pu. Adding +0.025 pu shifts all 10 samples into the normal band while keeping every value within the absolute limits [0.85, 1.10] pu (max 1.091 pu), giving the best count without absolute-limit violations. The +0.05 option pushes t09 to 1.116 pu, violating the absolute upper limit, and -0.025 worsens the low-voltage samples.
